_description: Component support matrix — for every common ecommerce UI component, defines native Shopify support, app alternatives, and custom development paths

limitations: No icon support in menu items
mega-menu.customAlternative: Custom header section with Liquid mega-menu block

sticky-header.notes: Built into all modern OS 2.0 themes

apps.name: Sticky Add to Cart Booster Pro

sticky-add-to-cart.customApproach: Custom section with position:sticky, clone product-form JS, attach to scroll event
sticky-add-to-cart.notes: Very common request. Most implementations are straightforward CSS position:sticky with a product form clone.

limitations: Dawn only has quick-add (single variant), not full quick-view modal with images/description
quick-view.customApproach: AJAX product fetch + modal overlay with product template clone

product-tabs.workaround: Use collapsible-content section blocks on product template — renders as accordion (not tabs)
product-tabs.customApproach: Custom product section with tabbed blocks using CSS/JS tab switching
product-tabs.notes: Collapsible content is the native alternative. For proper tab UI, custom development or app is needed.

size-chart.workaround: Product metafield (JSON or rich text) + collapsible tab block or popup block in product section
size-chart.customApproach: Product metafield (JSON) + popup/drawer section with size table rendering
size-chart.notes: Metaobjects are a clean native solution — create a 'Size Chart' metaobject, link to products via metafield reference.

wishlist.customApproach: Local storage or customer metafields + custom Liquid/JS
wishlist.notes: Complex to build custom — requires handling logged-in vs guest users, persistence, and wishlist page.

recently-viewed.customApproach: Browser localStorage tracking + AJAX product card rendering
recently-viewed.notes: Relatively simple with localStorage. Store product handles, fetch via Storefront API or /products/handle.json.

product-recommendations.notes: Uses Shopify's recommendation API. Install Search & Discovery app for manual recommendation control.

limitations: Cannot customize zoom level in theme settings
image-zoom.notes: Built into product media gallery in all modern themes.

cart-drawer.notes: Alternative is cart page. For upsell/cross-sell in cart, use apps like ReConvert or CartHook.

countdown-timer.customApproach: Custom Liquid section with JavaScript countdown + metafield for end date

reviews.customApproach: Not recommended — reviews require moderation, email collection, anti-spam, media uploads
reviews.effort: App: 1-2 hours setup. Custom: 80+ hours dev
reviews.notes: Always use an app for reviews. Building custom is not practical.

live-chat.notes: Shopify Inbox is free and built by Shopify. For advanced features (chatbots, helpdesk integration), use Tidio or Gorgias.

currency-switcher.notes: Shopify Markets handles multi-currency, multi-language, and regional pricing. No app needed for basic currency switching.

age-verification.customApproach: JavaScript modal on page load with cookie-based remember

back-in-stock.customApproach: Form submission to Klaviyo/Mailchimp list + product variant webhook

product-bundles.workaround: Shopify Bundles app (free, by Shopify) — basic bundle support
product-bundles.customApproach: Line item properties + Shopify Scripts (Plus) for bundle pricing
product-bundles.notes: Bundle pricing logic requires Shopify Scripts (Plus only) or an app. Shopify's free Bundles app handles basic use cases.

subscription.workaround: Shopify Subscriptions app (free, by Shopify) — basic subscription support
subscription.notes: Subscriptions require selling plan APIs. ReCharge is the market leader. Shopify's free app covers basic subscribe-and-save.

loyalty-program.effort: App: 2-4 hours setup. Custom: not recommended
loyalty-program.notes: Always use an app. Building a custom loyalty program from scratch is not feasible on Shopify.

product-360-view.customApproach: Custom Liquid section + JS library (e.g., three.js or Sirv 360) with image sprites
product-360-view.notes: Shopify natively supports 3D models (.glb files) and AR on product pages. For 360 spin from images, use an app or custom JS.

limitations: Filter UI customization limited in Dawn
advanced-filters.notes: Native filtering is good for most use cases. For complex faceted search, use Boost or Searchanise.

product-comparison.customApproach: LocalStorage-based comparison list + comparison page with metafield-driven specs table

infinite-scroll.customApproach: Intersection Observer + AJAX collection page fetch + DOM append
infinite-scroll.notes: Relatively simple with modern JavaScript. Some SEO considerations — ensure paginated URLs still work.

popup-modal.customApproach: Custom Liquid section + JS for trigger logic (exit intent, time delay, scroll depth)
popup-modal.notes: For email capture popups, most email platforms (Klaviyo, Privy) include popup builders.

store-locator.customApproach: Google Maps API + metaobjects for store data + custom page template

social-proof-notifications.customApproach: Webhook-triggered toast notifications using AJAX or websockets

gift-cards.notes: Built-in to Shopify. Gift card template is customizable in theme.

b2b-wholesale.requires: Shopify Plus (B2B on Shopify) or app
b2b-wholesale.notes: Shopify Plus includes native B2B features. For non-Plus stores, use wholesale apps.

multi-language.effort: Native via Shopify Markets. 2-4 hours setup
multi-language.notes: Shopify Markets handles multi-language natively. Translation apps add AI translation and better management UIs.

announcement-bar-advanced.workaround: Dawn supports single announcement bar with auto-rotation. For multiple bars, countdown, or images, use app or custom.
announcement-bar-advanced.customApproach: Custom section with multiple announcement blocks, JS rotation, and close/dismiss logic

video-background.workaround: Video section supports YouTube/Vimeo embed but not autoplay background. Some premium themes support video background natively.
video-background.customApproach: HTML5 video element with autoplay muted loop in custom Liquid section, positioned absolute behind content
video-background.notes: Performance concern: large video files impact page load. Use compressed MP4 and consider lazy loading.

parallax-scrolling.workaround: Studio theme has parallax sections. For other themes, custom CSS/JS needed.
parallax-scrolling.customApproach: CSS background-attachment:fixed or JS-based IntersectionObserver parallax with transform3d
parallax-scrolling.effort: 2-6 hours custom dev depending on complexity
parallax-scrolling.notes: CSS-only parallax is simple but limited. JS parallax gives more control but can impact performance on mobile.

limitations: Swatch colors defined via product variant metafields or CSV
Limited shape options (circle only in Dawn)
product-color-swatches.customApproach: Custom variant picker with metafield-driven color values or swatch images
product-color-swatches.notes: Dawn 7.0+ supports color swatches via variant metafields. For image-based swatches (fabric textures, patterns), use custom or app.

product-badges.workaround: Sale badge is native (shows when compare-at price set). Custom badges (New, Bestseller, Low Stock) require metafields + Liquid.
product-badges.customApproach: Product metafield (single_line_text or list) + Liquid conditional in product card snippet
product-badges.notes: Very common request. Sale badge is automatic. For custom badges, a product tag or metafield approach works well.

upsell-cross-sell.workaround: Product recommendations section exists natively but limited to 'You may also like' style. No cart upsell natively.
upsell-cross-sell.customApproach: Cart drawer modification + AJAX product fetch based on cart contents. Can use metafields for manual upsell assignments.
upsell-cross-sell.notes: Post-purchase upsells require Plus (Checkout Extensibility). Pre-purchase upsells in cart can be done on any plan.

limitations: Cannot customize pickup time slots natively
pickup-availability.notes: Native 'Pickup availability' block in product section. Shows which locations have the product in stock.

limitations: Limited visual customization of results dropdown
Cannot weight results by custom criteria
search-predictive.notes: Native predictive search works well for most stores. For AI-powered, typo-tolerant, merchandised search, use Searchanise or Boost.

scroll-to-top.workaround: Some themes include back-to-top button (Prestige, Impulse, Flex). For others, trivial custom JS.
scroll-to-top.customApproach: Fixed-position button with scroll event listener and smooth scrollTo

image-hotspots.customApproach: Custom section with positioned markers over image, tooltip/popup on click, metafield-driven coordinates
image-hotspots.notes: Impulse theme has native 'hotspots' section. For other themes, fully custom.

mega-footer.workaround: Default footer supports columns with link lists, text, images, newsletter, and social/payment icons. For more complex footers, custom Liquid.
mega-footer.customApproach: Custom footer section group with multiple section types (links, newsletter, social, map, etc.)

product-customizer.customApproach: Line item properties for text inputs + file upload via AJAX. Canvas-based preview for visual customization.
product-customizer.notes: Text engraving is simple (line item properties). Visual product builders (design-your-own) are very complex — always use an app.

shipping-calculator.customApproach: AJAX call to Shopify Shipping Rate API from cart page + display logic
shipping-calculator.notes: Cart page shipping estimator requires address input and API call to Shopify's rate endpoint.

order-tracking.workaround: Shopify order status page shows basic tracking with carrier links. For branded tracking pages, use app.
order-tracking.notes: Building custom requires carrier API integrations. Apps are strongly recommended.
